tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to the shopper's cart. For products with sizes/colors, pass the variation_id from get_product (not the parent product id). Returns the updated cart.

product_id.description: variation_id from get_product, or the product id for products without options.

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Apply a discount code the shopper gave you to the cart.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full details for one product: description, material, images and, for products with sizes/colors, every option with its variation_id, price and stock.

tools.name: get_shop_filters
tools.description: List the product categories, sizes and colors available on style4street (a Romanian women's fashion shop; names are in Romanian, prices in lei). Use the returned slugs with search_products.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: open_checkout
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the checkout page so the shopper can review the order, enter delivery details and pay themselves. The agent cannot place the order.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the style4street catalog. All filters are optional. Returns products with price, stock, sizes and colors; use get_product for details and the variation IDs needed to add a specific size/color to the cart.

query.description: Search words, e.g. "rochie neagra" or "trench". Romanian terms match best.

include_out_of_stock.description: Also return sold-out products. Default false.

sort.description: Default: relevance when a query is given, otherwise the shop order.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Change the quantity of a cart item, or remove it with quantity 0. Use the item key from view_cart.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Show the current cart: items (with their cart item keys), applied coupons, shipping and total.
